requests.description: The deletion of the account is irreversible, it will not be possible to resume synchronization as it is afterwards. - If transactions have been exported to accounting or used as payment, the CashflowSource will be left as it is. Resuming synchronization will remain impossible. If you re-import the account, a new CashflowSource will be created and transactions will therefore be duplicated. - Otherwise, if the CashflowSource was not used, it as well as its transactions will be deleted
